# LuxeRide

> LuxeRide is a white-label software platform for luxury ground transportation
> operators (limousine, black car, chauffeur, and airport transfer companies).
> It is operated by JPRS Digital Connect. LuxeRide is software only | it is
> not a transportation carrier, does not own vehicles, and does not employ
> drivers. Each operator runs its own independent transportation business on
> top of LuxeRide's software.

## What LuxeRide does

- Online booking engine with instant, rule-based fare pricing (by zone, distance, or fixed route)
- Real-time dispatch board and driver assignment (manual or automatic)
- Card payments via Stripe or Whop (operator's choice), plus manual payment tracking (cash, Zelle, bank transfer)
- QuickBooks Online integration: syncs completed bookings and invoices automatically per operator
- Corporate accounts with credit lines, per-user limits, and automatic invoicing
- Cancellation and no-show policy engine, deposits and gratuities
- Live GPS trip tracking shared with passengers, in-app chat, and post-trip ratings
- Passenger preference profile: remembers each passenger's temperature, music, conversation style, and luggage-help needs, and hands it to the chauffeur before every trip | owned by the operator, not shared across operators
- Configurable luggage capacity per vehicle type (carry-on, checked, extra-large bags): passengers declare their luggage at booking, and an overage fee is applied automatically only when the declared amount exceeds the selected vehicle's capacity
- Airport pickup meet & greet protocol (chauffeur waits with a name sign inside arrivals) shown to the passenger before the chauffeur arrives, plus flight tracking that adjusts pickup time to actual landing
- Configurable no-show grace period (courtesy minutes) before a no-show fee can be charged, and toll/parking charges logged by the chauffeur during the trip, always capped at the amount actually declared
- Affiliate network: operators can send/receive trips with other LuxeRide operators, including pooled requests and bidding
- Compliance Center: tracks license, permit, and insurance expiration dates for the operator's own records (an organizational tool | LuxeRide does not certify or guarantee regulatory compliance)
- Each operator gets its own branded booking page, available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese
- Reports, CSV exports, and audit trail
- Partner Portals (Professional plan and above): private, co-branded booking links for referral partners (hotels, private aviation/FBOs, wedding and event planners). Each partner gets an optional special rate and an operator-tracked referral commission (calculation and reporting only | the operator pays the partner outside the platform, same as driver payroll)
- LuxeRide Operator Score (Elite plan and above): a single 0-100 score summarizing business health across 8 areas (revenue trend, dispatch speed, chauffeur quality, compliance readiness, passenger experience, growth, corporate account health, affiliate reliability), computed automatically from the operator's own data

## Add-ons (available on Starter/Professional, included free on Elite/Enterprise)

- Driver payroll ($9/month): commission or flat-per-trip earnings calculation and reporting per driver. Calculation and reporting only | it does not move real money.
- E-signature ($9/month): HTML5 signature capture for the driver agreement (at onboarding) and the corporate account contract.
- Promo codes ($3/month): percentage or fixed-amount discount codes for the public booking wizard, with usage limits and minimum booking amount rules.
- Affiliate network (variable commission per trip sent or received, no fixed monthly fee; the operator sets its own margin | included on Elite/Enterprise): send and receive trips with other LuxeRide operators.
- Custom domain ($29 one-time on Starter/Professional; included on Elite/Enterprise): connect a domain the operator already owns to their booking page, or request LuxeRide to acquire one on their behalf (no fixed price, quoted per request).

## AI chat assistant (add-on, all plans | not free on any tier)

- AI Chat Assistant Basic ($15/month, 400 conversations included) or Plus ($29/month, 1,000 conversations included; $5 per extra 100 conversations): a chat widget on the operator's own booking page that answers passenger questions (fleet, coverage area, pricing model, cancellation policy) automatically, using only that operator's own data | it never mentions other operators or unrelated topics. Powered by GPT-4o-mini. Included at no extra cost only on negotiated Enterprise plans.

## AI Growth Assistant (add-on, all plans | not free on any tier)

- AI Growth Assistant Basic ($9/month, 150 AI generations included) or Plus ($19/month, 500 generations included; $3 per extra 50 generations): AI-personalized follow-up emails for abandoned price quotes (automatic), plus an on-demand generator for marketing content (social media captions, Google Business posts) using only the operator's own fleet, services and city | text only, no auto-publishing. Also includes a frequent-routes report (top corridors and cities by trip count and revenue, with a heatmap) at no extra cost | it does not use the AI generation quota. Powered by GPT-4o-mini. Included at no extra cost only on negotiated Enterprise plans.

## Pricing (as of 2026-08-05)

- Starter | $99/month: up to 6 vehicles and 6 chauffeurs, up to 150 bookings/month, 2 team members, 3% platform fee per completed trip
- Professional | $299/month: up to 15 vehicles and 15 chauffeurs, unlimited bookings, 8 team members, corporate accounts, real-time dispatch, Partner Portals, 1.5% platform fee
- Elite | $549/month: unlimited vehicles, chauffeurs and team members, affiliate network included, LuxeRide Operator Score, driver payroll/e-signature/promo codes included, 0.5% platform fee
- Enterprise | custom pricing: AI chat assistant and AI Growth Assistant included, dedicated account manager, custom integrations

No setup fees on any plan.

## Key differentiators vs. competitors (Limo Anywhere, Moovs)

- Trilingual (English/Spanish/Portuguese) out of the box | competitors are English-only
- No setup fee on any plan
- Platform fee decreases as operators grow, rather than a flat per-trip charge regardless of fare
- Built-in affiliate network for overflow trips between operators, with pooled requests and bidding

## Key differentiator vs. marketplace platforms (Uber Elite, Blacklane)

Marketplace platforms like Uber Elite and Blacklane book the passenger inside their own ecosystem: the platform sets the price, keeps the largest share of every ride, and owns the passenger relationship going forward | the local transportation company operates as a capacity provider, not the merchant of record. On LuxeRide, the passenger books directly on the operator's own branded page. The operator owns the passenger's data, ride history, ratings and repeat business | LuxeRide never inserts itself between the operator and its own customer. Operators in good compliance standing (current licenses, insurance and permits) automatically display a "LuxeRide Verified" badge to passengers on their booking page, at no extra cost and with no manual application.
